instruction: A working harbor dock at golden hour: a moored fishing trawler with masts and rigging, stacked shipping crates and lobster traps, a dockside crane, coiled ropes and bollards, gulls perched on pilings, a corrugated warehouse, and gentle water shimmering with sunset reflections. Buoys bob and the boat sways slowly at its mooring lines.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Harbor Docks at Evening. A working harbor dock at golden hour: a moored fishing trawler with masts and rigging, stacked shipping crates and lobster traps, a dockside crane, coiled ropes and bollards, gulls perched on pilings, a corrugated warehouse, and gentle water shimmering with sunset reflections. Buoys bob and the boat sways slowly at its mooring lines. Style: weathered realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
